sloka: जयेन वर्धयित्वा च मारीचप्रमुखास्ततः ।पुष्पकं भेजिरे सर्वे सान्त्विता रावणेन तु ।। ७.२३.३ ॥
transliteration: jayena vardhayitvā ca mārīcapramukhāstataḥ ।puṣpakaṁ bhejire sarve sāntvitā rāvaṇena tu ।। 7.23.3 ॥

translations.english: After Ravana had consoled them and celebrated their victory, Maricha and the other chiefs all boarded the Pushpaka chariot.
